info.name: DesignerJobs.com API
info.description: Black-box API tests for DesignerJobs.com. Folders 1-4 are the happy path (GREEN). Folders 5-6 follow the same TDD red board as the JUnit suite: they assert the behavior we WANT, so they are RED until the bugs are fixed / stubs implemented. Requires the backend running on {{baseUrl}}.

exec: pm.test('returns token + userId', function () { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.userId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('clientId comes from token, not body', function () { pm.expect(j.clientId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('clientId')); });
pm.test('senderId from token, not body', function () { pm.expect(j.senderId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('clientId')); });
pm.test('has at least one message', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.above(0); });
